title: Bug 649862: [Subcontracting] Restore Get Receipt Lines for subcontracting receipts
summary: Restores the ability to copy uninvoiced subcontracting receipts to separate purchase invoices, allowing cumulative vendor invoicing while correctly assigning vendor costs to the original Capacity Ledger Entry and production order.
key_points: Uninvoiced subcontracting receipts can now be included in Get Receipt Lines workflow
Posted receipt lines can be copied to separate purchase invoices for cumulative vendor invoicing
Posting correctly assigns vendor cost to original Capacity Ledger Entry without creating duplicate output
Supports untracked and item-tracked receipts from non-final routing operations
Item-tracked receipts from final operations and warehouse receipts remain explicitly blocked pending further validation
